items.title: 擂战鼓 ·提质量 | 当3D扫描遇上堵点 我们用AI来解决~
items.excerpt: AECC Harbin Dongan Engine describes deploying a ‘3D+2D+AI’ composite inspection system on an engine-production line. After 3D scanning struggled with small lock-tab features at about 75% recognition, the team added 2D vision and AI training; the company reports 100% recognition after iteration, plus reverse models for more than ten products and a 3D database.

items.title: Countdown to A350F first flight: Preparing for the sky
items.excerpt: Airbus details the A350F ‘Virtual First Flight’: 13 roughly five-hour simulator sessions connect a development flight-test simulator to real avionics benches, including actual flight controls and digital engine control. Airbus says the setup is 90% representative of the aircraft and precedes a 400-flight-hour, two-aircraft certification campaign with EASA involvement.

items.title: Unpacking the A350F’s new livery
items.excerpt: Airbus describes A350F paintshop engineering that combines a custom access setup with a digital zero-collision system using 3D laser mapping; the platform slows near the aircraft and stops 5 cm from the skin. The >90% composite airframe also uses a new flexible external primer to absorb thermal stress, while decorative films reduce paint layers and process time.

items.title: Introducing Saturn: Large-Format CT for the Parts You Couldn't Scan Before
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Lumafield launched Saturn, a 225 kV large-format industrial CT system with a 580 mm × 1,100 mm scan volume for dense aerospace structures and turbine/additive parts. Voyager supports porosity analysis, CAD comparison and automated GD&T; its combination of NDI hardware and manufacturing-intelligence software makes Lumafield worth continued aerospace-quality monitoring.
